title: Node.js Introduction Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of the Node.js runtime, use cases, installation basics, REPL usage, and module systems.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What is Node.js primarily used for?
questions.explanation: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime commonly used for servers, CLIs, scripts, and tooling outside the browser.

questions.prompt: Which command runs a file named `server.js` with Node.js?
questions.explanation: The `node` command executes JavaScript files with the Node runtime.

questions.prompt: Which pair belongs to CommonJS modules?
questions.explanation: CommonJS uses `require()` to import values and `module.exports` to expose them.

questions.prompt: What does the Node.js REPL help you do?
questions.explanation: The REPL is useful for quick experiments and runtime exploration.
